definitions.activity: One nonblank unique task-ledger row, not necessarily shipped or complete. No duplicate ids and six pending ids are distinct; committed rows are byte-equivalent JSON objects in primary snapshot.
definitions.reported_delivery: Behavioral/test-infrastructure delivery remaining after explicit row category exclusions. Not independently certified accepted production tasks; 19/43 commit fields null.
definitions.elapsed_minutes_from_record: verified_at minus started_at, including any recorded gaps. Self-reported timestamp span, often approximate; not measured active effort or model runtime.
definitions.verification_minutes_recorded: Self-reported verification effort, sometimes includes parallel verifier minutes; never added to elapsed span. Missing is null, not zero.
definitions.verification_tokens_recorded: Ledger field, mixed candidate/verifier scope and agents. Not total task tokens, invoice cost or controlled spend comparison.
definitions.lines_changed: Ledger additions+deletions as reported, may include docs/tests; missing not zero and tasks can overlap.
definitions.escaped_for_analytic_linked_rate: Ledger product/coverage defect linked to an existing reported-delivery task, discovered after that task verified_at. Distinct from pre-acceptance findings, pre-existing fixtures, docs and self-linked repair incidents.
definitions.reporting_lag: Discovery-to-record insertion latency; not reliably timestamped, remains null. Git insertion identifies an upper observation point, not exact reporting time.
definitions.cutoff: Source freeze at 06:53:25 +07, not all of Oct 24; no later primary edits/runs included.
definitions.money: No observed task invoice-cost field or matched baseline cost; no null-to-zero cost inference.

defects.summary: After the failed file transport was removed, Winston had no active transports and emitted every subsequent log record to stderr (including user payloads) while accumulating records in its unread stream; startup size cleanup could also delete current-day files and unreadable traffic subdirectories aborted sibling measurement.
defects.missed_because: The initial process-survival integration asserted only warning count and absence of an unhandled error, used EACCES rather than ENOSPC, and did not assert no Winston diagnostics/buffering. Retention tests covered oversized past days but not current-day over-budget entries or unreadable descendants; warning deduplication was instance-local.
defects.method_that_would_catch: Real /dev/full ENOSPC subprocess with multiple loggers and a multi-log turn asserting exactly one file-failure warning and no [winston] output; seeded oversized current-day app/traffic entries; unreadable traffic subdirectory alongside an oversized sibling; two LoggingService roots failing cleanup in one process.

analysis.reason: Found 4 minutes after author timestamp; high-risk task explicitly left independent review pending. Cannot call it an accepted-delivery escape.

defects.summary: Application-log current-day retention guard used UTC although DailyRotateFile names files by local date; during the local/UTC date divergence, size cleanup could remove the active local-day log. The /dev/full tests also symlinked the prior UTC date and did not exercise the sink.
defects.missed_because: Application log retention and ENOSPC fixtures derived term2 filenames from UTC ISO strings, so tests did not exercise timezone boundaries; traffic logs share UTC dates but application files do not.
defects.method_that_would_catch: Run focused logging and built CLI integration checks under TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati, assert local and UTC keys differ, and symlink the current local DailyRotateFile name to /dev/full; seed an oversized current local-day application file and verify it remains.

analysis.reason: Follow-up review exposed local/UTC retention and non-exercising fault fixture; two related logging misses, but neither accepted-completion escape nor ledger-labelled regression.

defects.summary: A queued submission could become queue-owning before queuedSubmissionCount became nonzero. Rollover request consumption passed it to the App callback, whose synchronous final admission check threw; the hook discarded the returned promise, producing an unhandled rejection and exiting the TUI.
defects.missed_because: The request-consumption preflight and final mutation guard used different queue signals, and the UI turn-end callback invoked an async operation with void and no rejection handler. No integration test covered the queue-owned/turn-end rollover interleaving.
defects.method_that_would_catch: Interactive CLI/PTY integration test that holds a turn open, queues a steer, requests session rollover, releases the turn, then asserts the process stays alive, the queued message is delivered exactly once, no successor rollover occurs while queue ownership remains, and no unhandled rejection is emitted.

analysis.reason: Found_at equals fixing task started_at, before its verified_at. Causal introducing task unknown; repair verification still pending.

defects.summary: Five CLI approval assertions misclassified their fixture as ordinary workspace data: inherited app-suffix TMPDIR made the pre-existing victim a permitted scratch target, producing YELLOW instead of RED refusal.
defects.missed_because: The fixture isolated HOME and XDG but inherited temporary-directory authority; it was only verified under ordinary host temp roots.
defects.method_that_would_catch: Run the real built-CLI approval cases with parent TMPDIR set to a Term2 sandbox scratch root, while separately isolating the child scratch root.

analysis.reason: One fixture class accounts for five failed assertions; independent baseline reproduction plus fixture-only repaired pass in identical app-suffix TMPDIR.

defects.summary: Bare outside-workspace denial fixture placed its absolute target inside the child's inherited sandbox scratch root, where explicit file writes are intentionally permitted; the test failed without demonstrating a production confinement regression.
defects.missed_because: The fixture treated outside-workspace as outside all allowed roots and did not distinguish scratch authority from workspace authority.
defects.method_that_would_catch: Built CLI plus loopback provider and filesystem matrix: deny outside both workspace and child scratch, allow explicit child-scratch writes; run under inherited app-suffix TMPDIR.

analysis.reason: Sixth assertion targeted permitted inherited scratch root. Independent reproduction and repaired scratch-write positive control, symlink/prefix negative controls.
